name: io.github.graydex.avbd
description: Augmented Vertex Block Descent (Giles, Diaz, Yuksel 2025) for Unity: rigid bodies, joints, springs and frictional contacts in one primal-dual solver, Burst-compiled. A port of the authors' avbd-demo3d.

samples.description: The 14 scenes of avbd-demo3d built from components, with a scene picker and mouse drag.
